1.consolidated_definition: comer. Carrito de compra. Carrito especial que utiliza el cliente en supermercados y tiendas para llevar la compra hasta la caja. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Hay dos ejemplos que me parece reveladores; uno, el del telespectador sentado frente al televisor con el mando a distancia pasando de un programa a otro, buscando no se sabe exactamente qué; otro exponente sería el del que va recorriendo el gran supermercado, llenando su shopping car hasta arriba, tentado por todos los estímulos y sugerencias comerciales, incapaz de decir que no (Boletín Informativo, PUCPR, 22-09-03)
1.en_consolidated_definition: to eat. Shopping cart. A special cart used by the customer in supermarkets and stores to carry purchases to the checkout counter. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. There are two examples that seem revealing; one is of a television viewer seated in front of the TV with the remote control switching from one program to another, searching for something unknown exactly; another example would be of someone browsing through the large supermarket, filling their shopping cart to the brim, tempted by all commercial stimuli and suggestions, unable to say no (PUCPR Information Bulletin, 09-22-03)
